info.description:
✨☁️ Transform Roblox into a dreamy pastel aurora experience. ☁️✨

Cloud Aurora redesigns Roblox with frosted pearl glass, soft pinks, lavender, aqua and sky-blue gradients, translucent surfaces, glowing accents and carefully layered contrast.

The theme refreshes the Roblox interface while preserving its original functionality, including the top navigation, search, sidebar, game pages, buttons, Marketplace, item thumbnails, menus, popovers and compatible extension interfaces.

✨ Features ✨:

• Pastel Aurora gradient system.

• Frosted pearl-glass navigation and panels.

• Redesigned Roblox sidebar.

• Aurora Play button.

Designed with clouds, pearl light and a little bit of aurora magic. ☁️✨

Created by:
☁️Cloud Aurora☁️ / @Aurora_Cloud

｡?°‧ Cloud Aurora ｡?°‧ — Final Polish Update.

Cloud Aurora has received its final major visual polish pass.

✨ What's new ✨:

• Redesigned the native Roblox Play button with the full Aurora gradient system.

• Completely themed the Marketplace header and controls.

• Removed the remaining dark Marketplace surfaces.

• Added pastel pearl backgrounds to item thumbnails.

• Redesigned Marketplace category/tag rails.

• Improved Marketplace buttons, filters and search styling.

• Refined hover and interaction states.

• Preserved white icon contrast where needed.

• Improved visual consistency between pink, lavender, aqua and pearl surfaces.

• Cleaned and reorganized the CSS structure for easier maintenance.

• Preserved compatibility layers for supported Roblox extensions.

• General stability and visual consistency improvements across Roblox.

========================================================


｡?°‧ Cloud Aurora ｡?°‧ was designed specifically for the Roblox website and is intended to be used with Stylish or another compatible userstyle extension.

The theme focuses on visual customization and does not intentionally modify Roblox functionality, navigation behavior or gameplay.

Some interface elements may vary depending on Roblox updates, account features or installed browser extensions.

Cloud Aurora includes compatibility styling for several commonly used Roblox extensions where supported.

For the intended appearance, keep the full stylesheet enabled on roblox.com.

Please preserve the original creator credits when sharing, modifying or redistributing this style.

Designed, styled and maintained by:
@Aurora_Cloud
